Items.Title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to amending and eliminating certain reporting requirements, to amend section 5 of such charter, relating to an annual statement to the council, to repeal section 17 of such charter, relating to a strategic policy statement, to repeal section 20-e of such charter, relating to a committee on city healthcare services, to amend subdivision g of section 20-m of such charter, relating to a report identifying critical gaps in mental health care, to amend subdivision c of section 2301 of such charter, relating to membership of the New York city taxi and limousine commission, to amend subdivision a of section 2302 of such charter, relating to an annual report by the New York city taxi and limousine commission, to amend paragraph 6 of subdivision b of section 2903 of such charter, relating to a report on the condition of all bridges and tunnels operated and maintained by the department of transportation, to amend the opening paragraph of section 3-181 of such code, relating to a report on domestic violence initiatives, indicators, and factors, to amend the opening paragraph of subdivision b of section 3-194 of such code, relating to a report on involuntary removals, to repeal section 14-175 of such code, relating to a marijuana enforcement report, to amend paragraph 2 of subdivision b of section 17-190 of such code, relating to a report on the deaths of homeless persons and homeless shelter residents, to amend subdivision i of section 17-191 of such code, relating to a report on child fatality cases, to amend the opening paragraph of subdivision e of section 17-194 of such code, relating to a report on drinking water tank inspections, to amend the opening paragraph of section 17-198 of such code, relating to a report on identifying and preventing the spread of hepatitis B and hepatitis C, to amend subdivision b of section 17-199.20 of such code, relating to a report on a citywide diabetes reduction plan, to amend section 17-325.2 of such code, relating to a report on food vendor license and food vending pushcart and vehicle permit renewals, suspensions, and revocations, to amend subdivision b of section 17-1208 of such code, relating to a report on pesticide use by city agencies, to amend subdivision c of section 17-1505 of such code, relating to a report on the activities of the food service establishment inspection ombuds office, to amend subdivision l of section 19-107.1 of such code, relating to a report evaluating the open streets program, to amend subdivision c of section 19-194 of such code, relating to a report on bike share program financial data, to amend subdivision m of section 19-506 of such code, relating to a report on enforcement against illegal operation of vehicles for hire, to amend section 19-529.7 of such code, relating to a report on safety in the commuter van industry, to amend subdivision f of section 31-112 of such code, relating to a report on LGBTQ veterans’ services, and to amend subdivision c of section 1 of local law number 118 for the year 2023, relating to a report on establishing crisis respite centers
Items.ActionText: This Introduction was Hearing Held by Committee
Items.MatterName: Amending and eliminating certain reporting requirements within the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York.
